review_candidates.title: Quality Monitoring Specialist-English-Speakers
review_candidates.description: Company Description Xceed is a leading multilingual Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) provider in the EMEA region, operating more than 10,000 web-enabled multichannel stations. The company manages outsourcing agreements for key government and commercial clients across 10 languages, delivering services such as inbound and outbound support, back-office operations, infrastructure management, recruitment process outsourcing, helpdesk support, and social media analysis. Xceed has operational sites in Egypt, Morocco, Mauritius, the UAE, and Saudi Arabia, offering diverse career opportunities in multiple locations. The organization is consistently recognized by IAOP, INSIGHTS Middle East Call Centre & CX Awards, Gulf Sustainability Awards, ICXA, IBXA, and Global ESG Awards for excellence in outsourcing, impact sourcing, sustainability, and diversity, equity, and inclusion. The role also involves collaborating with operations, training, and management teams to refine quality frameworks, support calibration sessions, and help implement process improvements. Job Requirement: -Call center experience in telecommunication field (Vodafone – Orange – EX WE- Vodafone UK- AT&T - etc. -Experience as a Quality Analyst is 6 months - Excellent in the English language.

review_candidates.title: Psychologist - EAMR Project
review_candidates.description: Job Description TITLE: Psychologist East African Migration Routes Project (EAMR) TEAM/PROGRAMME: Program Operation Egypt Country Office LOCATION: Cairo, Egypt GRADE : 5 CONTRACT LENGTH: Until Dec 2026. With possible extension based on performance and budget availability. Contingent upon confirmation of funding [1] Child Safeguarding Level 3: The post holder will have contact with children and/or young people either frequently (e.g. once a week or more) or intensively (e.g. four days in one month or more or overnight) because they work country programs; or are visiting country programs; or because they are responsible for implementing the police checking/vetting process staff. Organisation Profile / Programme Summary Save the Children International is the world’s leading independent organisation for children. We work in 120 countries and work, together with our partners, to inspire breakthroughs in the way the world treats children and to achieve immediate and lasting change in their lives. In Egypt, Save the Children International has been working to ensure that children’s rights are respected, protected and promoted since 1982. We carry out both long-term development work and, more recently emergency humanitarian work. This project aims that children and youth in vulnerable situations have their rights respected and possess sound self-reliance capacities that allow them to improve their life perspectives. It will also target national and community organizations to enable them to provide effective protection and self-reliance services for children and youth. Role Purpose The Psychologist will be responsible for providing psychosocial support services in compliance with the relevant SCI guidelines at the country office level in support migrant and refugee children under the supervision of the Mental Health and Psycho-social Support (MHPSS) Officer and the (MHPSS) Technical Advisor (TA), The Psychologist will contribute directly to protection case management processes by providing individual/group sessions for at risk children and youth in need of psychosocial support identified through the project activities and referrals from case management team and protection team. S/he will be responsible to conduct the needed assessments and customize the session topics based on the identified needs of the target group. S/he will also be responsible for organizing group support and awareness sessions to children at risk and their families and refer those with acute psychological needs to specialized services. Scope Of Role Reports To: MHPSS Officer Dotted Line To: MHPSS Technical Advisor Staff Directly Reporting to this Post: None Key Areas Of Accountability Project Implementation Psychologist Support Services In close collaboration with the MHPSS Officer and MHPSS TA, the psychologist will: Contribute to the design of intake forms, session plans, and follow-up forms for children and their families when relevant. Collaborate with the MEAL team to administer the psychometric assessments upon need and deliver reports and data accordingly. Develop psychological intervention plans for identified cases and follow up on them regularly. Conduct one to one and group counselling sessions with children and families referred from other activities. Identify and assess severe cases and refer them to appropriate psychological or psychiatric service providers. Coordinate closely with the EAMR Case Management team and other SCI projects to ensure timely internal referrals, follow-up, case consultations, and integrated support planning for children and families. Prepare and submit individual case reports for all cases on their caseload and document case progress. Attend one-to-one and group supervision meetings (Face to face and online) with the MHPSS Officer and the MHPSS TA to ensure quality of MHPSS interventions. Ensure that all psychological interventions offered are informed by current scientific evidence. Adhere to the highest standards of practice. Work closely with the MHPSS officer and project manager to develop and implement the project work plan and activities. Other Project Activities Facilitate and co-facilitate a rolling program of recreational and psychosocial support (PSS) programs. Assist the PSS/project team in material development, training deliveries on topics regarding needs identified. Support the MHPSS Officer in monitoring, reporting, indicator tracking, and logistical arrangements related to MHPSS activities Ensure that MHPSS activities are implemented in a full respect to the child safeguarding polices of SC. Support in staff well-being activities that does not affect the professional relationship and confidentiality of staff (For Example: peer to peer support groups, work related stress awareness raising and stress management training). Responsible for all the Relevant and logistics work related to MHPSS operations within the project. Reporting And Documentation Draft concise, useful and analytical reports, case studies, and other documents as needed on a monthly and quarterly basis and as requested by SC, donors and other stakeholders. Regular reporting to project Officer with projects updates. Organize and maintain filing system of the sessions. Other Responsibilities Work closely with the MHPSS Officer to develop and implement the project work plan and activities. To work closely with the MHPSS officer and MHPSS technical advisor and other MHPSS team members on the contextualization of MHPSS materials to different refugee languages and cultures. Organize and maintain project files; maintain electronic and paper records. In Case Of Emergency Promote children's rights, contributing to their well-being and protection in times of emergencies, guided by humanitarian principles and code of conduct. During emergencies, he/she should act in a way that facilitates SCI’s response to emergencies, giving priority to all assigned. Be prepared to support SCI interventions in response to emergencies and show needed flexibility. General Demonstrate leadership in relation to Save the Children policies and practice with respect to safeguarding, code of conduct, health and safety, equal opportunities and other relevant policies and procedures. Comply with Save the Children policies and practice with respect to safeguarding policy, code of conduct, health and safety, equal opportunities and other relevant policies and procedures. Accountability SKILLS AND BEHAVIOURS (our Values in Practice): Holds self-accountable for making decisions, managing resources efficiently, achieving and role modelling Save the Children values. Holds the team and partners accountable to deliver on their responsibilities - giving them the freedom to deliver in the best way they see fit, providing the necessary development to improve performance and applying appropriate consequences when results are not achieved. Ambition Sets ambitious and challenging goals for themselves (and their team), takes responsibility for their own personal development and encourages others to do the same. Widely shares their personal vision for Save the Children, engages and motivates others. Future orientated, thinks strategically. Collaboration Builds and maintains effective relationships, with their team, colleagues, members and external partners and supporters. Values diversity, sees it as a source of competitive strength. Approachable, good listener, easy to talk to. Creativity Develops and encourages new and innovative solutions. Willing to take disciplined risks. Integrity Honest, encourages openness and transparency. Qualifications And Experience A university degree in psychology. 2-3 years of experience in family and/or child individual and group counselling, experience in working with migrants and refugees is an asset. Highly developed interpersonal and communication skills including team-leading and influencing. Extensive experience in delivering training. Excellent written and oral communication skills in Arabic and English are required. Comfortable with high levels of ambiguity and able to take decisions independently in a fluid context. Experience with refugee/marginalized communities desired. Commitment to Save the Children values and Child Safeguarding. Additional Job Responsibilities The duties and responsibilities as set out above are not exhaustive and the role holder may be required to carry out additional duties within reasonableness of their level of skills and experience. Equal Opportunities The role holder is required to carry out the duties in accordance with the SCI Equal Opportunities and Diversity policies and procedures. Child Safeguarding We need to keep children safe so our selection process, which includes rigorous background checks, reflects our commitment to the protection of children from abuse. Safeguarding Our Staff The post holder is required to carry out the duties in accordance with the SCI anti-harassment policy Health and Safety The role holder is required to carry out the duties in accordance with SCI Health and Safety policies and procedures. Updated By: Afaf Gamal Date: 18. August.2026 JD agreed by: Date: Updated By: Afaf Gamal Date: 18.August.2026 Evaluated: Date: About Us The Organization Education We employ approximately 25,000 people across the globe and work on the ground in over 100 countries to help children affected by crises, or those that need better healthcare, education and child protection. We also campaign and advocate at the highest levels to realise the right of children and to ensure their voices are heard. We are working towards three breakthroughs in how the world treats children by 2030: No child dies from preventable causes before their 5th birthday All children learn from a quality basic education and that, Violence against children is no longer tolerated We know that great people make a great organization, and that our employees play a crucial role in helping us achieve our ambitions for children.We value our people and offer a meaningful and rewarding career, along with a collaborative and inclusive workplace where ambition, creativity, and integrity are highly valued. Application Information Please apply using a cover letter and up-to-date CV as a single document. Please also include details of your current remuneration and salary expectations. A copy of the full role profile can be found at www.savethechildren.net/jobs We need to keep children safe so our selection process reflects our commitment to the protection of children from abuse.

Medical and paramedical background is preferred Post graduate certificate or degree in public health / statistics, is preferred. Experience And Skills Minimum of 3–5 years of relevant professional experience in Health Information Systems, data management, monitoring and evaluation, or a related field, preferably with a UN agency or INGO. Previous experience working with health projects, humanitarian programmes, or vulnerable groups responses are highly desirable. Proven experience in data collection, data management, validation, analysis, and reporting, with strong attention to data quality and accuracy. review_candidates.title: Quality Assurance (QA) Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: Role Overview We are seeking a curious, detail-oriented, and self-driven QA Intern who can understand complex applications and business processes and help ensure the delivery of reliable, high-quality software. The successful candidate will contribute to both manual and automated testing across web applications, APIs, mobile applications, databases, and integrated systems. This role is ideal for someone with strong analytical and problem-solving skills who wants to build practical experience in modern software quality assurance. Key Responsibilities Understand complex application functionality, architecture, business processes, user journeys, and system integrations. Review requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, workflows, and technical documentation to identify test scenarios. Prepare and execute clear, comprehensive manual test cases and checklists. Perform functional, regression, integration, system, usability, compatibility, exploratory, and smoke testing. Assist in creating and maintaining automated tests for web applications and APIs. Validate APIs, database records, data flows, and integrations between systems. Identify, document, and track defects with clear descriptions, severity, reproduction steps, evidence, and expected results. Retest resolved issues and perform regression testing to confirm that fixes do not affect existing functionality. Work closely with developers, business analysts, product owners, and other QA team members throughout the development lifecycle. Participate in requirement reviews, planning sessions, defect discussions, and release-readiness activities. Maintain test documentation, execution results, defect records, and quality reports. Learn and apply QA standards, testing techniques, automation practices, and development processes. Take ownership of assigned tasks and communicate progress, dependencies, risks, and blockers proactively. Required Skills and Knowledge Basic understanding of software testing concepts and the software development lifecycle. Ability to analyze and understand complex applications, workflows, requirements, and business rules. Knowledge of manual testing techniques and test-case design. Basic understanding of test automation principles. Familiarity with one or more programming or scripting languages, such as JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, Python, or C#. Basic knowledge of web technologies, including HTML, CSS, HTTP, browsers, and client-server architecture. Familiarity with REST APIs and API-testing tools such as Postman. Basic SQL knowledge for validating application data and database results. Strong analytical, problem-solving, observation, and troubleshooting skills. Ability to document findings clearly and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical team members. Willingness to learn new applications, domains, tools, and technologies. Preferred Skills Exposure to automation tools such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, Appium, or similar frameworks. Familiarity with automated API testing. Exposure to performance or load-testing tools such as JMeter or k6. Basic understanding of Git, CI/CD pipelines, Agile development, and defect-tracking tools. Familiarity with testing web, mobile, cloud-based, or distributed applications. Awareness of accessibility, security, cross-browser, and responsive-design testing. Experience from academic, personal, internship, or open-source software projects. Qualifications Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree or diploma in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline. Academic or personal project experience involving software development or testing is an advantage. Relevant testing courses or entry-level certifications are beneficial but not required. Professional Competencies Detail-oriented, methodical, and committed to software quality. Curious and willing to investigate unexpected system behavior. Self-driven and accountable for assigned responsibilities. Able to learn complex applications and business domains quickly. Comfortable asking questions and challenging unclear requirements constructively. Works collaboratively and does not operate in silos. Communicates defects, risks, and progress clearly and professionally. Open to feedback and committed to continuous learning and improvement.

new_matches.description: Role Overview We are seeking a curious, detail-oriented, and self-driven QA Intern who can understand complex applications and business processes and help ensure the delivery of reliable, high-quality software. The successful candidate will contribute to both manual and automated testing across web applications, APIs, mobile applications, databases, and integrated systems. This role is ideal for someone with strong analytical and problem-solving skills who wants to build practical experience in modern software quality assurance. Key Responsibilities Understand complex application functionality, architecture, business processes, user journeys, and system integrations. Review requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, workflows, and technical documentation to identify test scenarios. Prepare and execute clear, comprehensive manual test cases and checklists. Perform functional, regression, integration, system, usability, compatibility, exploratory, and smoke testing. Assist in creating and maintaining automated tests for web applications and APIs. Validate APIs, database records, data flows, and integrations between systems. Identify, document, and track defects with clear descriptions, severity, reproduction steps, evidence, and expected results. Retest resolved issues and perform regression testing to confirm that fixes do not affect existing functionality. Work closely with developers, business analysts, product owners, and other QA team members throughout the development lifecycle. Participate in requirement reviews, planning sessions, defect discussions, and release-readiness activities. Maintain test documentation, execution results, defect records, and quality reports. Learn and apply QA standards, testing techniques, automation practices, and development processes. Take ownership of assigned tasks and communicate progress, dependencies, risks, and blockers proactively. Required Skills and Knowledge Basic understanding of software testing concepts and the software development lifecycle. Ability to analyze and understand complex applications, workflows, requirements, and business rules. Knowledge of manual testing techniques and test-case design. Basic understanding of test automation principles. Familiarity with one or more programming or scripting languages, such as JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, Python, or C#. Basic knowledge of web technologies, including HTML, CSS, HTTP, browsers, and client-server architecture. Familiarity with REST APIs and API-testing tools such as Postman. Basic SQL knowledge for validating application data and database results. Strong analytical, problem-solving, observation, and troubleshooting skills. Ability to document findings clearly and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical team members. Willingness to learn new applications, domains, tools, and technologies. Preferred Skills Exposure to automation tools such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, Appium, or similar frameworks. Familiarity with automated API testing. Exposure to performance or load-testing tools such as JMeter or k6. Basic understanding of Git, CI/CD pipelines, Agile development, and defect-tracking tools. Familiarity with testing web, mobile, cloud-based, or distributed applications. Awareness of accessibility, security, cross-browser, and responsive-design testing. Experience from academic, personal, internship, or open-source software projects. Qualifications Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree or diploma in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline. Academic or personal project experience involving software development or testing is an advantage. Relevant testing courses or entry-level certifications are beneficial but not required. Professional Competencies Detail-oriented, methodical, and committed to software quality. Curious and willing to investigate unexpected system behavior. Self-driven and accountable for assigned responsibilities. Able to learn complex applications and business domains quickly. Comfortable asking questions and challenging unclear requirements constructively. Works collaboratively and does not operate in silos. Communicates defects, risks, and progress clearly and professionally. Open to feedback and committed to continuous learning and improvement.
